title: Greenpill Earth Week
dek: For Earth Day 2026, Greenpill chapters planned cleanups, tree planting and teach-ins, and used Green Goods to document the work.
excerpt: Chapters in Nigeria, Kenya, Uganda and Koh Phangan put Earth Week events on the calendar, coordinated on the Regen Coordination Hub.
body:
On April 6, 2026, Afolabi opened a thread on the Regen Coordination Hub inviting Greenpill chapters to use Earth Day, Wednesday, April 22, to coordinate real regenerative action rather than only posting about it. The post suggested a few tracks: local cleanups or waste audits, community garden or tree-planting days, teach-ins on regeneration and public goods, mutual aid, and small public goods experiments that could continue after the day. It also proposed using Green Goods to document the work before, during and after the day.

## What chapters planned

- Greenpill Kenya planned plastic collection, tree planting, a composting demonstration and a class on using the Green Goods app at the Mortech Regen Hub.
- Greenpill Cape Town planned to help the Amava Uluntu organization in Vrygrond raise donations for its Peace Garden through a BackaBuddy campaign.
- GreenSofa shared a teaser of MEGAWEAVING, a community platform in Taiwan for sharing surplus resources, and proposed a resource mapping session.

## On the calendar

- April 22: Greenpill Nigeria cleaned and weeded around the Tech & Sun hub at Nnamdi Azikiwe University in Awka, as part of a clean-up drive and climate education session listed on Luma.
- April 22: GreenPill Uganda listed a tree planting event at Morikiswa primary school.
- April 22 to 26: Greenpill Kenya listed its Earth Day exercise at the Mortech Farmhouse in Nairobi.
- April 25: Greenpill Phangan listed an Earth Week cleanup marathon with Clean Phangan to Ko Tae Nai, near Thong Sala, with boat transport, kayaks and supplies covered by Green Goods micro-grants.
